note: disgust: action (disgust someone) or the feeling noun?
joke: event (to joke) or the thing?
respect: action (respect someone) or the quality?
infect: object = who is infected; also the infection
shame: feeling, like fupu; 'shame someone' possible
care: object or tun (care for X)?
fraud: the act (cheat someone) or the thing?
smell: also 'give off an odour' (no object)
protest: 'protest X' may take an object
wait: 'wait for X' may take an object
itch: like fupu; event or thing?
shock: action (shock someone) or the feeling?
divorce: event (divorce X) or the thing?
field action, but the gloss is the basin; sink (go under) is gumewe
play: 'play a game' may take an object
offering: the thing given, or the act (offer up X)?
judge: the person or the act (judge X)?
revenge: the act (avenge X) or the thing?
become: takes a complement, not an undergoer
plan: event (plan to X) or the thing?
fish: 'fish X' unusual; tiso is the animal
explode: transitive use (explode a bomb) possible
pray, worship: object = who is worshipped?
record: event (record X) or the recording?
depend: object = what it depends on
can: modal; is it an action word?
settle: object (settle a dispute) or intransitive (settle down)?
live: takes a duration (to nume fawu ka yawu); no verb object
experience: event (experience X) or the thing?
birth: event (give birth to X) or the thing?
vote: 'vote for X' may take an object
return: transitive use (return a thing) possible
escape: object = what is escaped? also intransitive
worry: object = what is worried about?
comment: 'comment on X' may take an object
fail: object = what failed (fail to X, fail a test); also intransitive
withdraw: object (withdraw money) or intransitive (pull back)?
excuse: action (excuse someone) or the thing (a pretext)?
